properties.title: Wasteland Atlas 2008 (GoI)
properties.description:
National assessment of wastelands for India by Indian Space Research Organization (ISRO). 
Following classes exist in the map: 

1. Scrub Land
2. Waterlogged Area
3. Degraded Forest
4. Degraded Land Under Plantation Crop
5. Sandy Area
6. Mining/ Industrial Wastelands
7. Barren Rocky Area
8. Gullied and Ravinous Land
9. Salt Affected Area
10. Degraded Pastures/ Grazing Land
11. Shifting Cultivation
12. Snow Covered/ Glacial Area
        
Details of the methodology can be found on [Bhuvan](https://bhuvan-app1.nrsc.gov.in/) portal.
